testcase.name: Scenario: View the top of a part and return to the home view: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:6:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: View the top of a part and return to the home view ✔ Given a part containing a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And its home view shows the block isometrically ✔ And the viewport orientation control is visible ✔ When the user selects the Top face of the orientation control ✔ Then the viewport shows the top of the block face-on as a rectangle ✔ And the orientation control displays Top ✔ And the same part and model browser remain active ✔ When the user selects the orientation control's Home action ✔ Then the viewport returns to the block's isometric home view ✔ And the same part and model browser remain active

testcase.name: Scenario: Step between adjacent orthogonal views: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:19:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Step between adjacent orthogonal views ✔ Given a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control displays the Front view ✔ When the user selects the right-side navigation arrow beside the orientation control ✔ Then the control displays Right ✔ And the block is displayed face-on from the right ✔ When the user selects the left-side navigation arrow ✔ Then the control displays Front ✔ And the block returns to the face-on front view ✔ And the same part and model browser remain active

testcase.name: Scenario: Rotate and restore a face-on view: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:31:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Rotate and restore a face-on view ✔ Given a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control displays Front with its label upright ✔ And the block's front face is wider than it is tall on screen ✔ When the user selects the upper curved rotation arrow on the orientation control ✔ Then the control still displays Front with its label rotated by a quarter turn ✔ And the block's front face is taller than it is wide on screen ✔ When the user selects the other curved rotation arrow ✔ Then the Front label is upright again ✔ And the block's front face is wider than it is tall again ✔ And the same part and model browser remain active

testcase.name: Scenario: Choose a corner from a face-on view: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:44:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Choose a corner from a face-on view ✔ Given a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control displays an upright Front view ✔ When the user selects the upper-right corner of the orientation control ✔ Then the block is displayed obliquely with its top, front and right faces visible ✔ And the orientation control shows the Top, Front and Right faces ✔ And the same part and model browser remain active

testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a compass preference change: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:53:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a compass preference change ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control is visible in the viewport ✔ And its compass preference is off ✔ When the user opens the orientation control context menu and chooses Options ✔ Then the options dialog displays controls for position, size and inactive opacity ✔ And it displays view transition and orientation settings ✔ And the compass option is unchecked and the north angle field is unavailable ✔ When the user enables the compass option ✔ Then the north angle field becomes available ✔ When the user cancels the options dialog and reopens it ✔ Then the compass option is unchecked ✔ And the north angle field is unavailable

testcase.name: Scenario: Move the orientation control to the opposite upper corner: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:68:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Move the orientation control to the opposite upper corner ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control and navigation bar are at the upper right of the viewport ✔ When the user opens the orientation control options ✔ And the user opens the on-screen position list ✔ Then the list offers Top Right, Bottom Right, Top Left and Bottom Left ✔ When the user chooses Top Left and confirms the options ✔ Then the orientation control appears at the upper left of the viewport ✔ And the navigation bar appears on the left side of the viewport ✔ And the part remains in its existing view ✔ When the user reopens the options ✔ Then the on-screen position displays Top Left ✔ When the user chooses Top Right and confirms ✔ Then the orientation control and navigation bar return to the right side ✔ And the same part and model browser remain active

testcase.name: Scenario: Change and restore the orientation control size: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:85:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change and restore the orientation control size ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control is visible with its size set to Automatic ✔ When the user opens the orientation control options and expands the size list ✔ Then the list offers Automatic, Tiny, Small, Normal and Large ✔ When the user chooses Large and confirms the options ✔ Then the orientation control is visibly larger in the viewport ✔ And the part remains in its existing view ✔ When the user reopens the options ✔ Then the size displays Large ✔ When the user chooses Automatic and confirms ✔ Then the orientation control returns to its earlier size in this viewport ✔ And the same part and model browser remain active

testcase.name: Scenario: Adjust the inactive opacity of the orientation control: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:100:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Adjust the inactive opacity of the orientation control ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control has 50 percent inactive opacity ✔ When the user opens the orientation control options and expands the inactive opacity list ✔ Then the list offers 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100 percent ✔ When the user chooses 100 percent and confirms the options ✔ And the user moves the pointer away from the orientation control ✔ Then the inactive control appears more opaque than at 50 percent ✔ And the part remains in its existing view ✔ When the user reopens the options, chooses 50 percent and confirms ✔ And the user moves the pointer away from the control ✔ Then the control returns to its earlier translucent appearance ✔ And the same part remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Switch between orthographic and perspective projection: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:115:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch between orthographic and perspective projection ✔ Given a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the block is displayed obliquely in Orthographic projection ✔ When the user opens the orientation control context menu ✔ Then Orthographic is marked as the current projection ✔ And Perspective and Perspective with Ortho Faces are offered ✔ When the user chooses Perspective ✔ Then the block remains visible in an oblique view with a changed projection ✔ And the same part and model browser remain active ✔ When the user reopens the orientation control context menu ✔ Then Perspective is marked as the current projection ✔ When the user chooses Orthographic ✔ Then the block returns to its orthographic appearance ✔ And the same part remains active

testcase.name: Scenario: Retain hybrid projection when selecting a named face: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:131:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain hybrid projection when selecting a named face ✔ Given a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And it is displayed obliquely in Orthographic projection ✔ When the user chooses Perspective with Ortho Faces from the orientation control menu ✔ Then the block remains visible in an oblique view with a changed projection ✔ When the user selects Top on the orientation control ✔ Then the block is displayed face-on from the top ✔ And the orientation control displays Top ✔ When the user reopens the orientation control menu ✔ Then Perspective with Ortho Faces is marked as the current mode ✔ When the user chooses Orthographic ✔ Then the same part remains active in the top view

testcase.name: Scenario: Show and hide the orientation compass: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:145:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show and hide the orientation compass ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with its Top view displayed ✔ And the orientation compass is disabled ✔ When the user opens the orientation control options ✔ And the user enables the compass and confirms the options ✔ Then a compass with north, east, south and west indicators appears around the orientation control ✔ And the part remains in the Top view ✔ When the user reopens the orientation control options ✔ Then the compass option is checked and its north angle field is available ✔ When the user disables the compass and confirms the options ✔ Then the compass disappears ✔ And the orientation control and the same part remain visible

testcase.name: Scenario: Enable and select the orientation control visibility scope: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:159:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Enable and select the orientation control visibility scope ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control options are open ✔ And showing the orientation control on window creation is enabled ✔ And Only in Current View is selected ✔ When the user clears the show-on-window-creation option ✔ Then the All 3D Views and Only in Current View choices are unavailable ✔ And the position, size and inactive opacity controls remain available ✔ When the user enables the show-on-window-creation option ✔ Then both visibility scope choices are available ✔ And Only in Current View remains selected ✔ When the user selects All 3D Views ✔ Then All 3D Views is selected and Only in Current View is cleared ✔ When the user selects Only in Current View ✔ Then Only in Current View is selected and All 3D Views is cleared ✔ When the user cancels the options ✔ Then the options close and the part view remains displayed

testcase.name: Scenario: Select the current top plane as the front plane and cancel: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:178:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select the current top plane as the front plane and cancel ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control options are open ✔ And the Front View Plane is XY(+Z) and the Top View Plane is XZ(+Y) ✔ When the user opens the Front View Plane list ✔ Then it offers XY(+Z), XY(-Z), XZ(+Y), XZ(-Y), YZ(+X) and YZ(-X) ✔ When the user selects XZ(+Y) as the Front View Plane ✔ Then the Front View Plane displays XZ(+Y) ✔ And the Top View Plane displays XY(+Z) ✔ When the user cancels the options and reopens them ✔ Then the Front View Plane displays XY(+Z) ✔ And the Top View Plane displays XZ(+Y)

testcase.name: Scenario: Set and restore the compass north angle: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:192:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Set and restore the compass north angle ✔ Given a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software in Top view ✔ And the compass is disabled and its north angle is 0 degrees ✔ When the user opens the orientation control options ✔ And the user enables the compass and enters 90 degrees as the north angle ✔ And the user confirms the options ✔ Then the compass is visible around the orientation control ✔ And its north indicator appears to the right of the Top face ✔ And the block remains in Top view ✔ When the user reopens the orientation control options ✔ Then the compass is enabled and the north angle is 90 degrees ✔ When the user changes the north angle to 0 degrees and confirms ✔ And the user selects Top on the orientation control ✔ Then the compass north indicator appears above the Top face ✔ When the user disables the compass in the orientation control options and confirms ✔ Then the compass is hidden and the block remains visible

testcase.name: Scenario: Place the orientation control in the lower viewport corners: tmp/obk-3961-snapshot/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:238:3

testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect view-definition choices without applying them ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user opens the orientation control context menu ✔ And the user expands Set Current View as ✔ Then the submenu offers Top and Front ✔ When the user expands Set Current View as Home ✔ Then the submenu offers Fixed Distance and Fit to View ✔ When the user presses Escape without choosing a submenu action ✔ Then the menus close and the same part view remains visible
